summary: Step 5 inline rename feature on Pros & Cons 8-Step Wizard tested end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844). Login as admin@test.com (USER LOGIN tab) → created 'Rename E2E test' analysis → Step 1 added direct factor 'AlphaOriginal' → Step 2 added option 'Opt1' → Step 3/4 skipped → Step 5 rename flows exercised. All requested behaviors PASS: pencil icon visible on Step 5 row, edit mode shows TextInput pre-filled with 'AlphaOriginal' plus Save/Cancel/Revert controls, Save persists rename and shows italic 'Originally: "AlphaOriginal"' hint, Back navigation to Step 4 and Step 1 still shows original 'AlphaOriginal' (display_name does NOT leak into Steps 1-4), forward navigation back to Step 5 restores 'AlphaRenamed' + hint, Revert link clears display_name and removes hint, Cancel discards edits, Steps 6/7/8 reflect displayName (renamed when active, original after revert). Backend PUT /factors/{id} accepts display_name=null clearing override correctly. No console errors related to the feature (only a benign 404 for an unrelated resource).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '[expo-av]: Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Use the `expo-audio` and `expo-video` packages to replace the required functionality.' — recommend migrating to expo-audio / expo-video.

action_items: (Optional) Add explicit testID props to RenamableFactorRow controls (pencil button, rename TextInput, Save/Cancel/Revert) to make future test selectors more robust — currently tests rely on accessibilityLabel ('Rename this factor', 'Save factor rename', 'Cancel rename') and the input placeholder 'Rename factor'. Functionality is fine; this is a testability nit.
Migrate away from deprecated expo-av to expo-audio / expo-video (SDK 54 removal).
critical_code_review_comments: displayName(f) helper is correctly used across Steps 5-8; Steps 1-4 keep using f.name. Verified via Back/Forward navigation.
Backend allowed-update set in /app/backend/routes/pros_cons.py includes 'display_name'; setting it to null successfully clears the override (Revert path works).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (9/9 scenarios passed: pencil visibility, edit mode pre-fill, Save persistence, Originally hint, Back→Step4 preserves original, Back→Step1 preserves original, Forward→Step5 restores renamed, Revert clears, Cancel discards, Step 6/7/8 reflect displayName both with rename active and after revert)
